sources.title: Models.dev: google/gemini-2.5-pro-preview
sources.evidence: The unsuffixed catalog key explicitly names Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview 06-05 and dates it June 5, 2025. This establishes the catalog identity being audited, not a first-party API alias or technical specification.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes
sources.evidence: June 5, 2025 explicitly releases gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05 with adaptive thinking. Earlier entries distinguish the March 25 experimental model, April 4 billing-enabled preview-03-25, and May 6 preview-05-06. The stable identifier launched June 17; the March and May preview IDs redirected June 26.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5: Updates to our family of thinking models (June 17, 2025)
sources.evidence: The announcement explicitly says Gemini 2.5 Pro GA has no changes from the 06-05 preview and directs preview users to gemini-2.5-pro. This is an exact-revision bridge between the June 5 preview and GA, not evidence equating earlier preview revisions. It identifies these as thinking models available through Google services.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro Model Card (updated June 27, 2025)
sources.evidence: The card explicitly evaluates gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05 alongside separate March and May revisions. It identifies sparse MoE Transformers, multimodal inputs and text output, and thinking/coding uses. It supplies no numerical total or active production-model parameter counts. The old modelcards.withgoogle.com URL redirects to the index; this replacement PDF was downloaded and read.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities
sources.evidence: Sections 2.1-2.3 describe sparse MoE Transformer architecture and training; Table 1 identifies Gemini 2.5 Pro as multimodal, dynamically thinking and tool-using. Total and per-token active parameter numbers are absent. Parameter sizes in cited papers are not Gemini sizes. The report includes evaluations through version 06-05; experimental audio-output variants do not establish audio output for this text endpoint.

sources.title: Gemini API model details: indexed June 2025 page with preview versions
sources.evidence: The search-indexed former model page explicitly lists preview-06-05 and preview-05-06 under Gemini 2.5 Pro, 1,048,576 input tokens, 65,536 output tokens, audio/image/video/text/PDF inputs, text output, thinking and function calling. The complete relevant indexed section was accessible; direct navigation now redirects to the current model index. Used as last-documented historical specifications, not proof of endpoint operation.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: Gemini API model reference
sources.evidence: The current stable-model page corroborates 1,048,576 input tokens and a separate 65,536 output limit, five supported input types, text output, thinking and function calling. Its listed model update is June 2025. Applicability to the June 5 revision is supported by the explicit unchanged-GA announcement, with historical preview documentation also checked.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Google API access is governed by service terms and restrictions, including restrictions on extracting underlying model weights. Together with the documented hosted release, this supports closed weights and a descriptive proprietary license classification; documentation and sample-code licenses are not model-weight licenses.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro Model Card (May 2026 edition)
sources.evidence: Inspected the later card and rendered page 5 comparison table, including the exact Gemini 2.5 Pro column. It reports benchmark results, not total or active parameter counts. The card provides no retrospective numerical count for the audited revision.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Flash Model Card (December 17, 2025)
sources.evidence: Inspected the later card and rendered page 4 table containing a Gemini 2.5 Pro Thinking column. The table contains capability results without total or active parameter rows; it supplies no count for this model.

sources.title: Gemini API deprecations
sources.evidence: Lists the dated 03-25, 05-06 and 06-05 Pro previews separately and records December 2, 2025 shutdown for them; 06-05 has release date June 5, 2025. It does not document the unsuffixed catalog key as a serving alias. Its conflicting March 3 date for 03-25 is not used; the contemporaneous changelog distinguishes that older revision.

name.note: The baseline name identifies the June 5 revision. The shortened catalog key is retained as its record identity; no first-party claim is made that the unsuffixed key was a functioning Google API alias.

developer.note: Google DeepMind developed and Google distributed this Gemini model; Google is the normalized catalog developer.

family.note: Normalized Pro subfamily, consistent with the explicitly identified Gemini2.5Pro revision and the stable record.

release_date.note: Earliest release of this exact 06-05 revision was June 5. June 17 is the unchanged stable identifier release. March 25, April 4 and May 6 concern earlier revisions or their API identifiers; no alias date replaces this revision date.

open_weights.note: Released for hosted Google services under API terms, with no public checkpoint distribution in the primary release material. Closed-weight classification is supported; model-card publication is not weight publication.

license.note: Descriptive classification for a hosted Google model governed by proprietary service terms. Not the CC BY or Apache license on the documentation and examples.

parameters_b.note: No numerical total is disclosed in the exact model card, training report, or inspected later cards and exact Gemini 2.5 Pro comparison columns. Targeted first-party training/interpretability searches supplied no further production count; no estimate is substituted.

active_parameters_b.note: MoE routing activates a subset per token, but the number or fraction is not reported. Later exact-model comparison columns do not disclose it. Neither cited research model sizes nor sparse-feature counts are treated as production parameters.

architecture.note: Explicitly described as sparse mixture-of-experts Transformers with native multimodal support. Normalize to moe; expert counts, dimensions and a decoder-only specification are not inferred.

context_window.note: The documented Gemini API input-token ceiling is 1,048,576. The separate 65,536-token output ceiling is not added to it. Historical indexed preview documentation is corroborated by the unchanged-GA bridge; no live endpoint invocation was performed.

modalities.note: Add video, which the baseline omitted. The dated preview supports PDF, image, text, audio and video input with text output. The separate Pro TTS endpoint and experimental native-audio variants do not confer audio output on this record.

reasoning.note: The June 5 release explicitly introduces adaptive thinking for this revision; the model card identifies reasoning before responding.

tool_call.note: Historical model documentation marks function calling supported, and the report defines tool use in terms of function calls. Confirmed for the revision, without transferring later tools such as File Search or Maps.

description.value: Google's June 2025 preview of Gemini 2.5 Pro, a multimodal thinking model with function calling and text output.
description.note: Replace generic promotional phrasing with the identified preview revision and documented capabilities.

patch.notes: This catalog key identifies the June 5, 2025 preview; the official API ID was gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05. Google promoted it unchanged to stable on June 17. Sparse MoE Transformer; parameter counts are undisclosed. The dated preview was shut down December 2, 2025. Earlier March and May revisions are distinct.

summary: Audited all 14 fields for the catalog-named June 5 preview. Keep its June 5 release date; distinguish the shortened catalog key from a verified Google API alias and from earlier March/May revisions. Add proprietary license, sparse MoE Transformer architecture, missing video input, factual description and primary provenance. Total and active parameters remain undisclosed after exact-card/training-report review, later exact-model comparison-table inspection, and targeted first-party training/interpretability searches. Limits describe the historical endpoint, not current operation.
